summary: Say the counting numbers in order by ones, all the way from 1 to 20.
Count in the right order and know which number comes just before or after another.
Recognize the written numbers up to 10 and say their names.
Count up to 10 objects or actions, matching one number word to each one.
Count up to 7 things that are scattered around, without skipping or double-counting.
Spot simple repeating patterns, then make and continue them.
Compare two groups by counting or matching and say which has more, fewer, or the same.
Notice how long, heavy, big or full everyday things are, using words like short, light, wide.
Compare two objects to tell which is longer or shorter, heavier or lighter, or the same.
Sort and group things by color, shape or size, and line them up in order.
Use position words like up, down, above, under, inside and outside to say where a thing is.
Name common shapes and talk about their parts, like sides and corners.
Build or model solid shapes such as a ball, a box and a tube with play materials.
